    Package Summary
    Package
    Description
    edu.brandeis.cosi.atg
    This library contains interfaces and type definitions for Automation: The Game (ATG).
    edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.cards
    This package contains a single class, Card, which contains the definition of card types that exist in the game.
    edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.decisions
    This package contains classes related to decisions made by players in the game.
    edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.engine
    This package contains classes related to the Engine.
    edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.player
    This package contains the interface for the Player, which should be implemented to provide automated or interactive players for the game.
    edu.brandeis.cosi.atg.state
    This package contains immutable data structures representing game state.
